### Capture
- **Seek Between Clips:** a batch now plays your original demos and jumps between clips instead of fast-forwarding patched copies — about twice as fast, and your demos are never rewritten.
- **The game stays out of your way:** batches run at full speed with DoD behind your windows or minimised, without stealing focus or the mouse. Untick *Keep the Game Behind Your Windows While Capturing* to watch it record instead.
- **HLTV demos list every player's highlights**, and capturing one follows that player in first person — including players who left before the demo ended.
- **Review highlights:** play every highlight in the game and mark it Yes or No before capturing; long gaps between kills fast-forward.
- **Finish clips automatically** when a batch ends, named from your own template; **command profiles** save your command lists; a summary strip shows the whole setup above Start Capture Batch.
- Safer batches: Studio refuses demos that changed since the scan, warns about demos or maps the game can't play, remembers maps a session crashed on, and asks before closing during a batch.

### In the game
- **DoD Studio's own window in the game:** Highlights, Demos (folders included), Playback, Console and Review tabs; resizable windows that remember where you left them; ESC behaves.
- **Spectating looks like POV:** one switch (`dodstudio_spec_match_pov`) gives a watched player the gun animations, gunshots, grenade priming, crosshair, gun lowering and prone camera of a POV demo; the sniper scope now shows in demos too.
- **Hide what you don't want in a clip:** the head-hit red screen and grenade shake, the spectator bars, map text, clan-match text, HLTV messages, the scoreboard, the crosshair, any sprite or particle, and more.
- **Jump around a demo:** `dodstudio_seek_to` / `_by`, and the in-game Highlights tab's Go button.

### Looks
- **HD textures:** AI-upscaled world textures, models, sprites, detail textures and skies, up to 4096 px, built from the HD Textures page, on both the original and the 25th Anniversary engine.
- **Overviews page:** clean, colour-coded map overviews made from the map itself, edited and saved for the game.
- **Blender page:** re-render a highlight in Blender from an `mirv_agr` capture.

### Demo tools
- **Demo Analyzer:** kill map with positions and engagement distance, a Flags tab (captures, blocks, cappers), filters by player, and SteamIDs in every format.
- **Demo Auditor:** Rename Demos from a template, and Split Maps for demos that span several maps.
- **Cache all:** analyse a whole folder ahead of time, so demos open instantly.

### Fixes
- The first demo of a session is no longer too dark; detail textures no longer switch off by position; several game crashes are guarded (temp entities, a previous map's collision data, an early HUD message, and a first-frame race in DoD Studio's own hook).
- **Safety:** the hook DLL refuses to join servers, so it can never run on a VAC-secured server.
